name: M&T BANK CORP

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Capital expenditures, net': $143M for FY2025, with $216M for FY2024 in the same statement (corroborated by the filer's 10-Q cash-flow statements: $87M for the nine months ended Sep 30, 2025 and $131M for the nine months ended Sep 30, 2024, with Q4 adding the remainder in each year)
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2024 and FY2025 of the last 3 in EDGAR companyfacts under every candidate tag the engine reads (the filed values through FY2023 came via PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets, $256M in FY2023). The engine applies this single FY2025 filing value to both missing periods; for FY2024 it understates true capex by $73M (~2% of that year's conservative OE, raising that year's OE — noted, not hidden), and capex at this level is immaterial to the verdict either way: FY2025 capex is ~4.8% of OCF and ~5% of conservative OE. ttm.py could not use the override to build a TTM base (it exits on a missing post-FY SBC YTD fact), so the override's effect is on the FY median base only.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Capital expenditures, net': $143M for FY2025, with $216M for FY2024 in the same statement (corroborated by the filer's 10-Q cash-flow statements: $87M for the nine months ended Sep 30, 2025 and $131M for the nine months ended Sep 30, 2024, with Q4 adding the remainder in each year)); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.1x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 3.4x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
